newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT - Sterling seen pausing around 2.84 marks.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT - Sterling seen pausing around 2.84 marks.

text.p: Sterling is seen pausing for breath after setting fresh 58-month highs above 2.84 marks on Thursday but the uptrend will remain intact as long as levels around 2.82 marks hold, said analysts.
"Sterling is gradually grinding higher, but it will be vulnerable to setbacks," said David Sneddon, technical analyst at Credit Suisse First Boston.
He said while the uptrend remains intact, with the pound seen assaulting new highs around 2.86 marks in the medium-term, it will need to hold around 2.82 marks for the trend to be sustained.
At 0735 GMT, sterling/mark was trading at 2.8393/00 against 2.8410/20 in late Europe on Thursday. Cable stood at $1.6465/75 vs $1.6480/90.
"The fact that we got above 2.8440 marks yesterday really suggests that this near-term uptrend will extend to its main objective which is 2.8660-2.87," said Sneddon.

But because sterling/mark failed on Thursday to accelerate above 2.8475 -- the highest since sterling was at 2.8543 marks in late July 1992 -- the pair could remain vulnerable to setbacks within the trend. Chartists, though, said a break below support around 2.82 marks was unlikely.
